summary: Frontend-only visual regression on /customer-stock-dashboard for CEO surya.yadavalli. All acceptance criteria met: 15 tiles rendered, 'Expected Next Order' label present as small uppercase slate text, right side shows coloured dot + date in text-sm (14px) font-semibold (600). No 'overdue' or 'in Nd' text anywhere on the page. Colours verified: red = rgb(190,18,60) rose-700, amber legend dot = rgb(180,83,9) amber-700, green = rgb(4,120,87) emerald-700. Em-dash '—' shown for the 6 tiles without orders. Legend (csd-legend) uses the same three colours. No console errors after login (only expected pre-login 401/400 during auth flow).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Distribution observed: red=8, amber=0, green=1, none(—)=6 out of 15 tiles. No amber tile occurred naturally, but legend/CSS classes and URGENCY map cover amber correctly (bg-amber-700 -> rgb(180,83,9)).
